name: system_default
notes: Returns an owned +1 device, or null if Metal is unavailable.

name: all
notes: Returns an owned +1 NSArray of devices. Elements are borrowed from the array; retain them to outlive it.

name: name
body:
NSString *value = ((id (*)(id, SEL))objc_msgSend)((id)object, sel_registerName("name"));
    return (const uint8_t *)[value UTF8String];
notes: Returns borrowed UTF-8 storage owned by the NSString property. Keep the device alive.

name: new_library_with_source
body:
NSString *source = [NSString stringWithUTF8String:(const char *)src];
    return (void *)[(id<MTLDevice>)object newLibraryWithSource:source options:(MTLCompileOptions *)options error:(NSError **)error];
notes: Returns an owned +1 object; release it when finished. Receiver and arguments must satisfy Metal availability and lifetime requirements. error receives a borrowed +0 NSError, including compilation warnings when a non-null result is returned; pass null to ignore. src is NUL-terminated UTF-8.

name: new_library_with_file
body:
NSString *filename = [NSString stringWithUTF8String:(const char *)file];
    return (void *)[(id<MTLDevice>)object newLibraryWithFile:filename error:(NSError **)error];
notes: Returns an owned +1 object; release it when finished. Receiver and arguments must satisfy Metal availability and lifetime requirements. error receives a borrowed +0 NSError, including compilation warnings when a non-null result is returned; pass null to ignore. file is a NUL-terminated UTF-8 filesystem path.

name: new_library_with_data
notes: Returns an owned +1 object; release it when finished. Receiver and arguments must satisfy Metal availability and lifetime requirements. error receives a borrowed +0 NSError, including compilation warnings when a non-null result is returned; pass null to ignore. library_data points to length readable bytes; dispatch copies the bytes before this returns.

name: new_buffer_with_bytes_no_copy
notes: Returns an owned +1 object; release it when finished. Receiver and arguments must satisfy Metal availability and lifetime requirements. bytes must satisfy Metal no-copy alignment and lifetime requirements. When has_deallocator is true, the copied block captures the callback/context values; keep both valid until Metal invokes the callback, potentially on another thread. The callback receives context, bytes, and length. When false, deallocator is not called and the caller retains responsibility for storage lifetime.
